steps.name: Every included trial extracted
steps.detail: 312 of 509 included papers extracted (two independent readings each).

steps.name: Disagreements settled by a third reading
steps.detail: 0 numbers judged by a third reading; 549 waiting (in 128 trials).

steps.name: Review queue resolved or clearly flagged
steps.detail: 1,818 numbers verified; 935 in review (published flagged, not as verified).

steps.name: Independent audits
steps.detail: 2 audits; latest 2026-10-22: 16 of 17 sampled numbers correct.

steps.name: Human validation (150 numbers, blind)
steps.detail: Sample 'pilot' drawn (30 numbers); waiting for a validator.

steps.name: One record per trial
steps.detail: Merge duplicate primary publications of the same trial (shared registration numbers). Planned before release 1.0.

steps.name: Licence chosen for data and code
steps.detail: Andrew's decision. CC BY 4.0 for the data and MIT for the code are common choices.

steps.name: Copyright check of the quoted abstract sentences
steps.detail: The dataset quotes one sentence per number from PubMed abstracts. Confirm this can be redistributed, or ship links and positions instead.

steps.name: Data dictionary
steps.detail: Field definitions are in the protocol (section 5); a standalone data dictionary file ships with the release.

steps.name: Frozen release 1.0 with a DOI
steps.detail: Zenodo archives a GitHub release and assigns a DOI, for free.

steps.name: Human expert co-author
steps.detail: A clinician or epidemiologist, ideally the one who validates the sample.

steps.name: Target journal
steps.detail: A data journal, for example Scientific Data or Data in Brief. Check fees and AI-use policies.

steps.name: Manuscript draft
steps.detail: Background, methods (from the protocol), data records, technical validation (audits and human validation), usage notes.
